searches.reason: Develop controlled sequence interventions that reveal whether rankings depend on recent, repeated interests or isolated old interactions. Measure top-10 rank changes after masking recent events, removing isolated purchases, and shuffling order; compare against matched random removals. Connect findings to sequence encoding and training objectives without claiming causal effects on user preferences.

searches.reason: Translate qualitative feedback into evidence-based probes for unsupported prerequisites, compatibility, and recently satisfied durable needs. Research title/description-based evidence extraction with explicit supported, contradicted, and unknown states. Validate on manually reviewed recommendations for the twenty training users; treat immediate-choice feedback as reported preference and never infer ownership, hidden traits, or dislikes from missing evidence.

searches.reason: Establish whether diagnostics predict ranking failures and useful interventions rather than merely describing embeddings or easy training negatives. Investigate popularity-matched negatives, final-position probes, embedding effective rank, and sampled-versus-full-catalog rank agreement. Report category-level uncertainty and missing-data status; calibrate using training-only temporal holdouts, then assess aggregate alignment with the fixed macro validation HR@10 within the GPU budget.
